py/tuple:
! =============================================================================

sh_UnID = 1000
lod2D = 0										! Don't draw anything

gs_fillFr		= gs_bFills * gs_fillFr
gs_fillSh		= gs_bFills * gs_fillSash
gs_penSh_fg		= gs_bFills * gs_penSash_fg
gs_penSh_bg		= gs_bFills * gs_penSash_bg
gs_fillShCover	= gs_bFills * gs_fillShCover


! =============================================================================
! GS Corner Window Functions
! =============================================================================

call "GS Corner Window Functions",
	parameters all	gs_IsCurved				= gs_IsCurved,
					bParalellInCurvedWalls	= bParalellInCurvedWalls,
					bDisabeMirroring		= bDisabeMirroring,

					bLeftCornerFunction		= bLeftCornerFunction,
					leftCornerAngle			= leftCornerAngle,
					bLeftDiffConnWall		= bLeftDiffConnWall,
					leftConnWallThk			= leftConnWallThk,
					bRightCornerFunction	= bRightCornerFunction,
					rightCornerAngle		= rightCornerAngle,
					bRightDiffConnWall		= bRightDiffConnWall,
					rightConnWallThk		= rightConnWallThk,
	returned_parameters	ac_unit_width,
						gs_frame_ovhg_left_out,
						gs_frame_ovhg_right_out,
						gs_frame_ovhg_left_in,
						gs_frame_ovhg_right_in,
						bMirrored,
						addPrmX, addPrmY,
						mulPrmX, mulPrmY,
						iLoD2D,

						gs_opLinePen,
						gs_iSwingType,
						gs_iSlidingType,
						gs_swingLineType,
						bShowAddHotspots, bShowUnitHotspots

if iLoD2D = 0 then end

add2 addPrmX, addPrmY
mul2 mulPrmX, mulPrmY

lod2D					= DET2D_FS_OFF
bFullSashOpeningIn2D	= 0
iSymbolGlassType		= SYMBGLASS_SIMPLEGLASS
_bShowRebateOnFixGlass	= 0
_bShowRebateOnFrame		= 1

if iLoD2D = SYMBW_S_1LINE then				lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE 		! Simple - One Line --> INT 200
if iLoD2D = SYMBW_S_CENTERLINE then			lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE 		! Simple - Centerline --> SWE 200
if iLoD2D = SYMBW_S_2LINE_ACC then			lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_TWO 		! Simple - Two Lines
if iLoD2D = SYMBW_S_2LINE then				lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI			! Chinese Simple
if iLoD2D = SYMBW_M_2LINE_GLASS then		lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE 			! Middle - without acc
if iLoD2D = SYMBW_M_2LINE_NOGLASS then		lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_TWO 		! Middle - with acc --> INT 100
if iLoD2D = SYMBW_M_FRAMESASH then			lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED			! NLD 100
if iLoD2D = SYMBW_D_SGLASS then				lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED 			! Detailed --> INT 50, DAN 20
if iLoD2D = SYMBW_D_REBATEONGLASS then		lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED 			! Detailed --> NLD 50
if iLoD2D = SYMBW_D_SGLASS then				lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED 			! Detailed --> INT 50, DAN 20
if iLoD2D = SYMBW_D_2GLASS then				lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED 			! Detailed --> NOR 50
if iLoD2D = SYMBW_D_2LINE_HS then			lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED_CHI		! Chinese Detailed

if iLoD2D = SYMBW_M_FRAMESASH then			! NLD Middle
	_bShowRebateOnFrame		= 0
endif
if iLoD2D = SYMBW_D_REBATEONGLASS	then 	! Detailed --> NLD 50
	_bShowRebateOnFixGlass	= 1
endif
if iLoD2D = SYMBW_D_2GLASS then 			! Detailed --> NOR 50
	bFullSashOpeningIn2D	= 1
	iSymbolGlassType		= SYMBGLASS_DOUBLEGLASS
endif


! =============================================================================
! Draw window frame and sash
! =============================================================================
if gs_transom_display = 0 then

	bListView = (GLOB_CONTEXT = 6 | GLOB_CONTEXT = 46)
	_halfA		= ac_unit_width/2
	_refWidth	= ac_unit_width
	_leftWidth	= ac_unit_width / 2 + gs_tolerance_left
	_rightWidth	= ac_unit_width / 2 + gs_tolerance_right

	if abs(WIDO_ORIG_DIST) > EPS & gs_IsCurved then

		! =============================================================================
		! Curved window panel - Chinese simple and detailed symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI | lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED_CHI then

			pen gs_pen_2D
			fill gs_fillShCover

			if GLOB_SCRIPT_TYPE <> 2 & GLOB_CONTEXT <> 22 then
				widoOrigDist = -WIDO_ORIG_DIST
			else
				widoOrigDist =  WIDO_ORIG_DIST
			endif

			signrotangle		= (ABS(SYMB_ROTANGLE-180) < EPS) - not(SYMB_ROTANGLE)
			signrevealside		= not(WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE) - WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE
			SymbolMid_shiftDy	= (WIDO_SILL - WALL_THICKNESS / 2 + WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS / 2) * signrevealside
			wallIsLeft			= (SYMB_ROTANGLE > EPS) exor WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE
			signWallIsLeft		= wallIsleft - not(wallIsleft)

			WOD = abs(widoOrigDist) + signrotangle * (SymbolMid_shiftDy)

			alpha = atn(_halfA / (WOD - (ABS(SYMB_ROTANGLE-180) < EPS) * WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS))

			Rad = _halfA / sin(alpha) - signrotangle * (SymbolMid_shiftDy)/ cos(alpha) + signrotangle * (SymbolMid_shiftDy)

			poly2_b{2} 5, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillFr > 0) + 4 + 8 + 16 + 32, gs_penShCov_fg, gs_penShCov_bg,
				0, 0, 0,
				0, -signrotangle * WOD, 901,
				(Rad + WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS) * sin(alpha), -signrotangle * (WOD - (Rad + WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS) * cos(alpha)), 1,
				-(Rad + WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS) * sin(alpha), -signrotangle * (WOD - (Rad + WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS) * cos(alpha)), 3000,
				-Rad * sin(alpha), -signrotangle * (WOD - Rad * cos(alpha)), 1,
				Rad * sin(alpha), -signrotangle * (WOD - Rad * cos(alpha)), 3000
			end
		endif

		if gs_frame_pen_cont = 0 then gs_frame_pen_cont = gs_pen_2D

		bGlass 	= (lod2D > 20)
		s1_bEndLines = 1		! was: bListView

		WOD = abs(WIDO_ORIG_DIST)
		if WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE = (SYMB_ROTANGLE > EPS) then
			iSign = -1
			NWOD = WOD - WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE * WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS
		else
			iSign = 1
			NWOD = WOD + WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE * WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS
		endif

		alpha = atn(_refWidth / 2 / NWOD)
		Rad = NWOD / cos(alpha)

		add2 0, WIDO_ORIG_DIST
		if (SYMB_ROTANGLE > EPS) then
			mul2 1,1
		else
			mul2 1,-1
		endif

		ArcLengthToAngle = 180 / Rad / PI
		alfaFrameWidth = (gs_frame_width) * ArcLengthToAngle

		alfa_left_ovh_in = gs_frame_ovhg_left_in
		alfa_left_ovh_out = gs_frame_ovhg_left_out

		alfa_right_ovh_in = gs_frame_ovhg_right_in
		alfa_right_ovh_out = gs_frame_ovhg_right_out

		sideA = Rad
		sideB = Rad - iSign * gs_frame_thk
		sideBSolidPanel = Rad - iSign * gs_frame_thk

		toleranceLeft	= _leftWidth - _halfA
		toleranceRight	= _rightWidth - _halfA
		dx = (toleranceRight - toleranceLeft) / 2

		alfaLeft  = atn((_halfA + dx) / (NWOD - (WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE = (SYMB_ROTANGLE < EPS)) * WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS))
		alfaRight = atn((_halfA - dx) / (NWOD - (WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE = (SYMB_ROTANGLE < EPS)) * WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS))


		! =============================================================================
		! Curved window panel - Simple symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE then
			pen gs_pen_2D
			line_property 0

			arc2 0,0, Rad, 90 - alfaRight, 90 + alfaLeft

			if bShowUnitHotspots then
				hotspot2 Rad * sin(-alfaLeft - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out),  Rad * cos(-alfaLeft - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out),  100
				hotspot2 Rad * sin(alfaRight + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out), Rad * cos(alfaRight + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out), 101
			endif

			end ! =============================================================== END =
		endif


		! =============================================================================
		! Curved window panel - Basic and Detailed symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & lod2D<>DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI & lod2D <> DET2D_FS_DETAILED_CHI then

			sAlfa = sin(alfaFrameWidth)
			cAlfa = cos(alfaFrameWidth)

			pen gs_frame_pen_cont
			line_property 2
			fill gs_fillFr

			! left window frame
			rot2 alfaLeft

			px1 = sideB * sin(-alfa_left_ovh_in)
			py1 = sideB * cos(-alfa_left_ovh_in)
			px2 = sideA * sin(-alfa_left_ovh_out)
			py2 = sideA * cos(-alfa_left_ovh_out)

			poly2_b 6, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
					px1,			py1,			32 + s1_bEndLines,
					px2,			py2,			32 + 1,
					0,				0,				32 + 901,
					sideA * sAlfa,	sideA * cAlfa,	32 + 3001,
					sideB * sAlfa,	sideB * cAlfa,	32 + 1,
					0,				sideB,			32 + 3001

			! Tolerance separator line
			line2 0, sideA, 0, sideB

			! Unit hotspots
			if bShowUnitHotspots then
				hotspot2 0, sideA, 100
				hotspot2 0, sideB, 102
			endif

			del 1
		
			! right window frame
			rot2 -alfaRight

			px1 = -sideB * sin(-alfa_right_ovh_in)
			py1 =  sideB * cos(-alfa_right_ovh_in)
			px2 = -sideA * sin(-alfa_right_ovh_out)
			py2 =  sideA * cos(-alfa_right_ovh_out)

			poly2_b 6, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
					px1,			py1,			32 + s1_bEndLines,
					px2,			py2,			32 + 1,
					0,				0,				32 + 901,
					-sideA * sAlfa,	sideA * cAlfa,	32 + 3001,
					-sideB * sAlfa,	sideB * cAlfa,	32 + 1,
					0,				sideB,			32 + 3001

			! Tolerance separator line
			line2 0, sideA, 0, SideB

			! Unit hotspots
			if bShowUnitHotspots then
				hotspot2 0, sideA, 101
				hotspot2 0, SideB, 103
			endif

			del 1

			pen gs_pen_2D

			alfaRightPos = alfaRight - alfaFrameWidth
			alfaLeftPos  = alfaLeft  - alfaFrameWidth

			! --- glass line in the center of the frame ---
			if bGlass then
				arc2 0,0, sideA - iSign * gs_frame_thk / 2, 90 - alfaRightPos, 90 + alfaLeftPos
			endif

			! --- horizontal lines and cover fill ---
			fill gs_fillShCover

			if iMullionStyle = MULLION_SOLID_PANEL then
				poly2_b 5, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillShCover > 0) + 4 + 16 + 64, gs_penShCov_fg, gs_penShCov_bg,
					0,0, 901,
					sideA * sin(-alfaLeftPos),				sideA * cos(-alfaLeftPos),	1,
					sideA * sin(alfaRightPos),				sideA * cos(alfaRightPos),	3000,
					sideBSolidPanel * sin(alfaRightPos),	sideBSolidPanel * cos(alfaRightPos),	1,
					sideBSolidPanel * sin(-alfaLeftPos),	sideBSolidPanel * cos(-alfaLeftPos),	3000

				fill gs_fillSh
				line_property 2
				poly2_b 5, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillSh > 0) + 4 + 16 + 64, gs_penSh_fg, gs_penSh_bg,
					0,0, 901,
					sideB * sin(-alfaLeftPos),				sideB * cos(-alfaLeftPos),	32 + 1,
					sideB * sin(alfaRightPos),				sideB * cos(alfaRightPos),	3032 + 1,
					sideBSolidPanel * sin(alfaRightPos),	sideBSolidPanel * cos(alfaRightPos),	32 + 1,
					sideBSolidPanel * sin(-alfaLeftPos),	sideBSolidPanel * cos(-alfaLeftPos),	3032 + 1
			else
				poly2_b 5, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillShCover > 0) + 4 + 16 + 64, gs_penShCov_fg, gs_penShCov_bg,
					0,0, 901,
					sideA * sin(-alfaLeftPos),	sideA * cos(-alfaLeftPos),	1,
					sideA * sin(alfaRightPos),	sideA * cos(alfaRightPos),	3000,
					sideB * sin(alfaRightPos),	sideB * cos(alfaRightPos),	1,
					sideB * sin(-alfaLeftPos),	sideB * cos(-alfaLeftPos),	3000
			endif
		endif

		del 2

	else

		bCornerWindow = (ac_cw_function & ac_corner_window)

		gs_frame_left_endline_comp	= 1 + (gs_left_oversize < EPS)
		if gs_frame_left_endline_comp = 2 then
			bDrawLeftEndLine = bListView
		else
			bDrawLeftEndLine = (gs_frame_left_endline_comp = 1)
		endif

		gs_frame_right_endline_comp	= 1 + (gs_right_oversize < EPS)
		if gs_frame_right_endline_comp = 2 then
			bDrawRightEndLine = bListView
		else
			bDrawRightEndLine = (gs_frame_right_endline_comp = 1)
		endif

		_rebate_width = gs_frame_width/2
		_rebate_depth = gs_frame_thk/2


		! =============================================================================
		! Straight window panel - Chinese simple and detailed symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI | lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED_CHI then
			pen gs_pen_2D
			fill gs_fillShCover

			poly2_b{2} 4, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillFr > 0) + 4 + 8 + 64, gs_penShCov_fg, gs_penShCov_bg,
					0, 0, 0,
					-_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out,	 0,				1,
					 _halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out,	 0,				0,
					 _halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in,	-gs_frame_thk,	1,
					-_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_in,	-gs_frame_thk,	0

			_frame_width_left  = gs_frame_width
			_frame_width_right  = gs_frame_width

			_leftSashPosition	= -_halfA + _frame_width_left
			_rightSashPosition	=  _halfA - _frame_width_right

			gosub "hotspot editing"
			gosub "opening line"

			pen gs_pen_2D
			gosub "tolerance line"
			gosub "unit hotspots"

			end ! =============================================================== END =
		endif

		if gs_frame_pen_cont = 0 then gs_frame_pen_cont = gs_pen_2D


		! =============================================================================
		! Straight window panel - Simple symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE then
			_frame_width_left  = gs_frame_width + gs_sash_width - _rebate_width
			_frame_width_right  = gs_frame_width + gs_sash_width - _rebate_width

			pen gs_pen_2D
			if iTypeDemolitionFill = 1 then
				line_type gs_Demolition_linetype
			else
				line_type 1
			endif

			if not(WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE) then
				line2  -_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out,	0,
						_halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out,	0
			else
				line2  -_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_in,		-gs_frame_thk,
						_halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in,	-gs_frame_thk
			endif

			! --- hotspot editing and opening line ------------------------------------
			pen gs_pen_2D
			line_property 0

			_leftSashPosition	= -_halfA + _frame_width_left
			_rightSashPosition	=  _halfA - _frame_width_right

			add2 0, -gs_frame_thk * (WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE)
			gosub "hotspot editing"
			gosub "opening line"
			gosub "unit hotspots"
			del 1

			end ! =============================================================== END =
		endif


		! =============================================================================
		! Straight window panel - Basic symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_TWO | lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE | lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA then

			_frame_width_left  = gs_frame_width + (gs_sash_width - _rebate_width) * (lod2D <> DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA)
			_frame_width_right = gs_frame_width + (gs_sash_width - _rebate_width) * (lod2D <> DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA)

			pen gs_frame_pen_cont
			line_property 2
			fill gs_fillFr

			! --- left window frame ---------------------------------------------------
			poly2_b 4, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
					-_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out,	 0,				32 + 1,
					-_halfA + _frame_width_left,		 0,				32 + 1,
					-_halfA + _frame_width_left,		-gs_frame_thk,	32 + 1,
					-_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_in,	-gs_frame_thk,	32 + bDrawLeftEndLine

			if lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA then
				add2 0, -(gs_frame_thk - gs_sash_thk) / 2
				poly2_b 4, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left,					 0,				32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left + gs_sash_width,	 0,				32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left + gs_sash_width,	-gs_sash_thk,	32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left,					-gs_sash_thk,	32
				del 1
			endif

			! --- right window frame --------------------------------------------------
			poly2_b 4, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
					_halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out,	 0,            32 + 1,
					_halfA - _frame_width_right,		 0,            32 + 1,
					_halfA - _frame_width_right,		-gs_frame_thk, 32 + 1,
					_halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in,	-gs_frame_thk, 32 + bDrawRightEndLine

			if lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA then
				add2 0, -(gs_frame_thk - gs_sash_thk) / 2
				poly2_b 4, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right,					 0,				32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right - gs_sash_width,	 0,				32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right - gs_sash_width,	-gs_sash_thk,	32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right,					-gs_sash_thk,	32
				del 1
			endif

			if iTypeDemolitionFill = 1 then
				line_type gs_Demolition_linetype
			else
				line_type 1
			endif

			pen gs_pen_2D
			line_property 0

			! --- glass line in the center of the frame --------------------------------
			if bFrCornerLeft <> 0 then
				_leftGlassPos = -_halfA + _frame_width_left + (lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA) * gs_sash_width
			else
				_leftGlassPos = -halfA - (gs_frame_ovhg_left_out + gs_frame_ovhg_left_in) / 2
			endif

			if bFrCornerRight <> 0 then
				_rightGlassPos = _halfA - _frame_width_right - (lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA) * gs_sash_width
			else
				_rightGlassPos = _halfA + (gs_frame_ovhg_right_out + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in) / 2
			endif

			if lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE | lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA then
				line2	_leftGlassPos,  -gs_frame_thk/2,
						_rightGlassPos, -gs_frame_thk/2
			endif

			! --- horizontal lines and cover fill --------------------------------------
			if lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA then
				_frame_thk = gs_sash_thk
				add2 0, -(gs_frame_thk - gs_sash_thk) / 2
			else
				_frame_thk = gs_frame_thk
			endif

			if bFrCornerLeft = 0 then
				_leftIn		= -_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_in
				_leftOut	= -_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out
			else
				_leftIn		= -_halfA + _frame_width_left + (lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA) * gs_sash_width
				_leftOut	= _leftIn
			endif

			if bFrCornerRight = 0 then
				_rightIn	= _halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in
				_rightOut	= _halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out
			else
				_rightIn	= _halfA - _frame_width_right - (lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA) * gs_sash_width
				_rightOut	= _rightIn
			endif

			fill gs_fillShCover

			poly2_b 4, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillShCover > 0) + 4 + 16 + 64, gs_penShCov_fg, gs_penShCov_bg,
					_leftOut,	 0,				1,
					_rightOut,	 0,				0,
					_rightIn,	-_frame_thk,	1,
					_leftIn,	-_frame_thk,	0

			if lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA then del 1

			! --- hotspot editing and opening line ------------------------------------
			pen gs_pen_2D
			line_property 0

			_leftSashPosition	= -_halfA + _frame_width_left
			_rightSashPosition	=  _halfA - _frame_width_right

			gosub "hotspot editing"
			gosub "opening line"

			pen gs_frame_pen_cont
			line_property 2

			gosub "tolerance line"
			gosub "unit hotspots"
		endif


		! =============================================================================
		! Straight window panel - Detailed symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED then

			pen gs_frame_pen_cont
			line_property 2
			fill gs_fillFr

			! --- left window frame ---------------------------------------------------
			_frame_width_left  = gs_frame_width
			if bFrCornerLeft <> 0 then
				poly2_b 6, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
						-_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out,				 0,								32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left - _rebate_width,	 0,								32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left - _rebate_width,	-gs_frame_thk + _rebate_depth,	32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left,					-gs_frame_thk + _rebate_depth,	32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left,					-gs_frame_thk,					32 + 1,
						-_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_in,				-gs_frame_thk,					32 + bDrawLeftEndLine
			endif

			! --- right window frame --------------------------------------------------
			_frame_width_right  = gs_frame_width
			if bFrCornerRight <> 0 then
				poly2_b 6, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
						_halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out,				 0,								32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right + _rebate_width,	 0,								32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right + _rebate_width,	-gs_frame_thk + _rebate_depth,	32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right,					-gs_frame_thk + _rebate_depth,	32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right,					-gs_frame_thk,					32 + 1,
						_halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in,				-gs_frame_thk,					32 + bDrawRightEndLine
			endif

			_leftSashPosition	= -_halfA + _frame_width_left - _rebate_width
			_rightSashPosition	=  _halfA - _frame_width_right + _rebate_width

			pen gs_pen_2D
			if iTypeDemolitionFill = 1 then
				line_type gs_Demolition_linetype
			else
				line_type 1
			endif

			! --- horizontal lines and cover fill --------------------------------------

			fill gs_fillShCover

			poly2_b 8, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillShCover > 0) + 4 + 16 + 64, gs_penShCov_fg,	 gs_penShCov_bg,
				 _leftSashPosition + gs_sash_width,		 gs_sash_thk -_rebate_depth,	0,
				 _leftSashPosition + gs_sash_width,		-_rebate_depth,					0,
				-_halfA + _frame_width_left,			-_rebate_depth,					0,
				-_halfA + _frame_width_left,			-gs_frame_thk,					1,
				 _halfA - _frame_width_right,			-gs_frame_thk,					0,
				 _halfA - _frame_width_right,			-_rebate_depth,					0,
				 _rightSashPosition - gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth,					0,
				 _rightSashPosition - gs_sash_width,	gs_sash_thk -_rebate_depth,		1

			line2	_leftSashPosition + gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth,
					_rightSashPosition - gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth

			! --- glass line in the center of the sash frame --------------------------------

			line2	_leftSashPosition + gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth + gs_sash_thk/2,
					_rightSashPosition - gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth + gs_sash_thk/2

			! --- sash fill for both sides --------------------------------------------
			pen gs_frame_pen_cont
			fill gs_fillSh
			line_property 2

			! left sash frame
			poly2_b 4, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillSh > 0) + 4 + 16 + 32, gs_penSh_fg, gs_penSh_bg,
					_leftSashPosition,					-_rebate_depth,					32 + 1,
					_leftSashPosition + gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth,					32 + 1,
					_leftSashPosition + gs_sash_width,	 gs_sash_thk -_rebate_depth,	32 + 1,
					_leftSashPosition,					 gs_sash_thk -_rebate_depth,	32 + 1

			! right sash frame
			poly2_b 4, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillSh > 0) + 4 + 16 + 32, gs_penSh_fg, gs_penSh_bg,
					_rightSashPosition,					-_rebate_depth,					32 + 1,
					_rightSashPosition - gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth,					32 + 1,
					_rightSashPosition - gs_sash_width,	 gs_sash_thk -_rebate_depth,	32 + 1,
					_rightSashPosition,					 gs_sash_thk -_rebate_depth,	32 + 1

			! --- hotspot editing and opening line ------------------------------------
			pen gs_pen_2D
			line_property 0

			gosub "hotspot editing"
			gosub "opening line"

			pen gs_frame_pen_cont
			line_property 2

			gosub "tolerance line"
			gosub "unit hotspots"
		endif
	endif
endif

end


! =============================================================================
"hotspot editing":
! =============================================================================
	unID = sh_UnID
	rev_A = 512
	rev_B = 0

	sash_thk_oh = 0
	if lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED then
		sash_thk_oh = gs_sash_thk/2
	endif

	add2 0, sash_thk_oh

	hotspot2 _rightSashPosition, 0, unID,		gs_open_2D, 6 + rev_A	! Center
	hotspot2 _leftSashPosition,  0, unID + 1,	gs_open_2D, 4+128		! Base
	hotspot2 _rightSashPosition-(abs(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition))*cos(gs_open_2D),
				(abs(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition))*sin(gs_open_2D),
				unID + 2, gs_open_2D,5						! Moving
	unID = unID + 3
	del 1

	sh_UnID = unID
return


! =============================================================================
"opening line":
! =============================================================================
	if abs(gs_open_2D) > EPS & abs(gs_open_2D - 360) > EPS then

		pen gs_opLinePen

		line2	_rightSashPosition, sash_thk_oh,
				_rightSashPosition-(abs(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition))*cos(gs_open_2D),
				(abs(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition))*sin(gs_open_2D) + sash_thk_oh

		line_type gs_swingLineType

		if gs_iSwingType = 1 then		! Curved
			arc2	_rightSashPosition, sash_thk_oh, ABS(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition), 180-gs_open_2D, 180
		else							! Straight
			line2	_leftSashPosition, sash_thk_oh,
					_rightSashPosition-(abs(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition))*cos(gs_open_2D),
					(abs(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition))*sin(gs_open_2D) + sash_thk_oh
		endif

		line_type SYMB_LINETYPE
	endif
return


! =============================================================================
"tolerance line":
! =============================================================================
	if lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & lod2D <> DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI then
		if bFrCornerLeft <> 0 then
			if lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & (gs_frame_ovhg_left_out > EPS | gs_frame_ovhg_left_in > EPS) then
				line2 -_halfA, 0,
					  -_halfA, -gs_frame_thk
			endif
		endif

		if not(bCornerWindow) & bFrCornerRight <> 0 then
			if lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & (gs_frame_ovhg_right_out > EPS | gs_frame_ovhg_right_in > EPS) then
				line2 _halfA, 0,
					  _halfA, -gs_frame_thk
			endif
		endif
	endif
return


! =============================================================================
"unit hotspots":
! =============================================================================
	if bShowUnitHotspots then
		unit_UnID = 1
		if bLeftCornerFunction then
			hotspot2 -_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out,  0,            unit_UnID
			hotspot2 -_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_in,  -gs_frame_thk * (lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & lod2D <> DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI), unit_UnID + 2
		else
			hotspot2 -_halfA,  0,            unit_UnID
			hotspot2 -_halfA, -gs_frame_thk * (lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & lod2D <> DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI), unit_UnID + 2
		endif
		if not(bCornerWindow) | bRightCornerFunction then
			if bRightCornerFunction then
				hotspot2  _halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out,  0,            unit_UnID + 1
				hotspot2  _halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in,  -gs_frame_thk * (lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & lod2D <> DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI), unit_UnID + 3
			else
				hotspot2  _halfA,  0,            unit_UnID + 1
				hotspot2  _halfA, -gs_frame_thk * (lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & lod2D <> DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI), unit_UnID + 3
			endif
		endif
	endif
return

! =============================================================================
! Draw window frame and sash
! =============================================================================
if gs_transom_display = 0 then

	bListView = (GLOB_CONTEXT = 6 | GLOB_CONTEXT = 46)
	_halfA		= ac_unit_width/2
	_refWidth	= ac_unit_width
	_leftWidth	= ac_unit_width / 2 + gs_tolerance_left
	_rightWidth	= ac_unit_width / 2 + gs_tolerance_right

	if abs(WIDO_ORIG_DIST) > EPS & gs_IsCurved then

		! =============================================================================
		! Curved window panel - Chinese simple and detailed symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI | lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED_CHI then

			pen gs_pen_2D
			fill gs_fillShCover

			if GLOB_SCRIPT_TYPE <> 2 & GLOB_CONTEXT <> 22 then
				widoOrigDist = -WIDO_ORIG_DIST
			else
				widoOrigDist =  WIDO_ORIG_DIST
			endif

			signrotangle		= (ABS(SYMB_ROTANGLE-180) < EPS) - not(SYMB_ROTANGLE)
			signrevealside		= not(WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE) - WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE
			SymbolMid_shiftDy	= (WIDO_SILL - WALL_THICKNESS / 2 + WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS / 2) * signrevealside
			wallIsLeft			= (SYMB_ROTANGLE > EPS) exor WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE
			signWallIsLeft		= wallIsleft - not(wallIsleft)

			WOD = abs(widoOrigDist) + signrotangle * (SymbolMid_shiftDy)

			alpha = atn(_halfA / (WOD - (ABS(SYMB_ROTANGLE-180) < EPS) * WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS))

			Rad = _halfA / sin(alpha) - signrotangle * (SymbolMid_shiftDy)/ cos(alpha) + signrotangle * (SymbolMid_shiftDy)

			poly2_b{2} 5, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillFr > 0) + 4 + 8 + 16 + 32, gs_penShCov_fg, gs_penShCov_bg,
				0, 0, 0,
				0, -signrotangle * WOD, 901,
				(Rad + WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS) * sin(alpha), -signrotangle * (WOD - (Rad + WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS) * cos(alpha)), 1,
				-(Rad + WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS) * sin(alpha), -signrotangle * (WOD - (Rad + WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS) * cos(alpha)), 3000,
				-Rad * sin(alpha), -signrotangle * (WOD - Rad * cos(alpha)), 1,
				Rad * sin(alpha), -signrotangle * (WOD - Rad * cos(alpha)), 3000
			end
		endif

		if gs_frame_pen_cont = 0 then gs_frame_pen_cont = gs_pen_2D

		bGlass 	= (lod2D > 20)
		s1_bEndLines = 1		! was: bListView

		WOD = abs(WIDO_ORIG_DIST)
		if WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE = (SYMB_ROTANGLE > EPS) then
			iSign = -1
			NWOD = WOD - WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE * WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS
		else
			iSign = 1
			NWOD = WOD + WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE * WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS
		endif

		alpha = atn(_refWidth / 2 / NWOD)
		Rad = NWOD / cos(alpha)

		add2 0, WIDO_ORIG_DIST
		if (SYMB_ROTANGLE > EPS) then
			mul2 1,1
		else
			mul2 1,-1
		endif

		ArcLengthToAngle = 180 / Rad / PI
		alfaFrameWidth = (gs_frame_width) * ArcLengthToAngle

		alfa_left_ovh_in = gs_frame_ovhg_left_in
		alfa_left_ovh_out = gs_frame_ovhg_left_out

		alfa_right_ovh_in = gs_frame_ovhg_right_in
		alfa_right_ovh_out = gs_frame_ovhg_right_out

		sideA = Rad
		sideB = Rad - iSign * gs_frame_thk
		sideBSolidPanel = Rad - iSign * gs_frame_thk

		toleranceLeft	= _leftWidth - _halfA
		toleranceRight	= _rightWidth - _halfA
		dx = (toleranceRight - toleranceLeft) / 2

		alfaLeft  = atn((_halfA + dx) / (NWOD - (WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE = (SYMB_ROTANGLE < EPS)) * WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS))
		alfaRight = atn((_halfA - dx) / (NWOD - (WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE = (SYMB_ROTANGLE < EPS)) * WIDO_FRAME_THICKNESS))


		! =============================================================================
		! Curved window panel - Simple symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE then
			pen gs_pen_2D
			line_property 0

			arc2 0,0, Rad, 90 - alfaRight, 90 + alfaLeft

			if bShowUnitHotspots then
				hotspot2 Rad * sin(-alfaLeft - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out),  Rad * cos(-alfaLeft - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out),  100
				hotspot2 Rad * sin(alfaRight + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out), Rad * cos(alfaRight + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out), 101
			endif

			end ! =============================================================== END =
		endif


		! =============================================================================
		! Curved window panel - Basic and Detailed symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & lod2D<>DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI & lod2D <> DET2D_FS_DETAILED_CHI then

			sAlfa = sin(alfaFrameWidth)
			cAlfa = cos(alfaFrameWidth)

			pen gs_frame_pen_cont
			line_property 2
			fill gs_fillFr

			! left window frame
			rot2 alfaLeft

			px1 = sideB * sin(-alfa_left_ovh_in)
			py1 = sideB * cos(-alfa_left_ovh_in)
			px2 = sideA * sin(-alfa_left_ovh_out)
			py2 = sideA * cos(-alfa_left_ovh_out)

			poly2_b 6, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
					px1,			py1,			32 + s1_bEndLines,
					px2,			py2,			32 + 1,
					0,				0,				32 + 901,
					sideA * sAlfa,	sideA * cAlfa,	32 + 3001,
					sideB * sAlfa,	sideB * cAlfa,	32 + 1,
					0,				sideB,			32 + 3001

			! Tolerance separator line
			line2 0, sideA, 0, sideB

			! Unit hotspots
			if bShowUnitHotspots then
				hotspot2 0, sideA, 100
				hotspot2 0, sideB, 102
			endif

			del 1
		
			! right window frame
			rot2 -alfaRight

			px1 = -sideB * sin(-alfa_right_ovh_in)
			py1 =  sideB * cos(-alfa_right_ovh_in)
			px2 = -sideA * sin(-alfa_right_ovh_out)
			py2 =  sideA * cos(-alfa_right_ovh_out)

			poly2_b 6, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
					px1,			py1,			32 + s1_bEndLines,
					px2,			py2,			32 + 1,
					0,				0,				32 + 901,
					-sideA * sAlfa,	sideA * cAlfa,	32 + 3001,
					-sideB * sAlfa,	sideB * cAlfa,	32 + 1,
					0,				sideB,			32 + 3001

			! Tolerance separator line
			line2 0, sideA, 0, SideB

			! Unit hotspots
			if bShowUnitHotspots then
				hotspot2 0, sideA, 101
				hotspot2 0, SideB, 103
			endif

			del 1

			pen gs_pen_2D

			alfaRightPos = alfaRight - alfaFrameWidth
			alfaLeftPos  = alfaLeft  - alfaFrameWidth

			! --- glass line in the center of the frame ---
			if bGlass then
				arc2 0,0, sideA - iSign * gs_frame_thk / 2, 90 - alfaRightPos, 90 + alfaLeftPos
			endif

			! --- horizontal lines and cover fill ---
			fill gs_fillShCover

			if iMullionStyle = MULLION_SOLID_PANEL then
				poly2_b 5, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillShCover > 0) + 4 + 16 + 64, gs_penShCov_fg, gs_penShCov_bg,
					0,0, 901,
					sideA * sin(-alfaLeftPos),				sideA * cos(-alfaLeftPos),	1,
					sideA * sin(alfaRightPos),				sideA * cos(alfaRightPos),	3000,
					sideBSolidPanel * sin(alfaRightPos),	sideBSolidPanel * cos(alfaRightPos),	1,
					sideBSolidPanel * sin(-alfaLeftPos),	sideBSolidPanel * cos(-alfaLeftPos),	3000

				fill gs_fillSh
				line_property 2
				poly2_b 5, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillSh > 0) + 4 + 16 + 64, gs_penSh_fg, gs_penSh_bg,
					0,0, 901,
					sideB * sin(-alfaLeftPos),				sideB * cos(-alfaLeftPos),	32 + 1,
					sideB * sin(alfaRightPos),				sideB * cos(alfaRightPos),	3032 + 1,
					sideBSolidPanel * sin(alfaRightPos),	sideBSolidPanel * cos(alfaRightPos),	32 + 1,
					sideBSolidPanel * sin(-alfaLeftPos),	sideBSolidPanel * cos(-alfaLeftPos),	3032 + 1
			else
				poly2_b 5, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillShCover > 0) + 4 + 16 + 64, gs_penShCov_fg, gs_penShCov_bg,
					0,0, 901,
					sideA * sin(-alfaLeftPos),	sideA * cos(-alfaLeftPos),	1,
					sideA * sin(alfaRightPos),	sideA * cos(alfaRightPos),	3000,
					sideB * sin(alfaRightPos),	sideB * cos(alfaRightPos),	1,
					sideB * sin(-alfaLeftPos),	sideB * cos(-alfaLeftPos),	3000
			endif
		endif

		del 2

	else

		bCornerWindow = (ac_cw_function & ac_corner_window)

		gs_frame_left_endline_comp	= 1 + (gs_left_oversize < EPS)
		if gs_frame_left_endline_comp = 2 then
			bDrawLeftEndLine = bListView
		else
			bDrawLeftEndLine = (gs_frame_left_endline_comp = 1)
		endif

		gs_frame_right_endline_comp	= 1 + (gs_right_oversize < EPS)
		if gs_frame_right_endline_comp = 2 then
			bDrawRightEndLine = bListView
		else
			bDrawRightEndLine = (gs_frame_right_endline_comp = 1)
		endif

		_rebate_width = gs_frame_width/2
		_rebate_depth = gs_frame_thk/2


		! =============================================================================
		! Straight window panel - Chinese simple and detailed symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI | lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED_CHI then
			pen gs_pen_2D
			fill gs_fillShCover

			poly2_b{2} 4, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillFr > 0) + 4 + 8 + 64, gs_penShCov_fg, gs_penShCov_bg,
					0, 0, 0,
					-_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out,	 0,				1,
					 _halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out,	 0,				0,
					 _halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in,	-gs_frame_thk,	1,
					-_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_in,	-gs_frame_thk,	0

			_frame_width_left  = gs_frame_width
			_frame_width_right  = gs_frame_width

			_leftSashPosition	= -_halfA + _frame_width_left
			_rightSashPosition	=  _halfA - _frame_width_right

			gosub "hotspot editing"
			gosub "opening line"

			pen gs_pen_2D
			gosub "tolerance line"
			gosub "unit hotspots"

			end ! =============================================================== END =
		endif

		if gs_frame_pen_cont = 0 then gs_frame_pen_cont = gs_pen_2D


		! =============================================================================
		! Straight window panel - Simple symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE then
			_frame_width_left  = gs_frame_width + gs_sash_width - _rebate_width
			_frame_width_right  = gs_frame_width + gs_sash_width - _rebate_width

			pen gs_pen_2D
			if iTypeDemolitionFill = 1 then
				line_type gs_Demolition_linetype
			else
				line_type 1
			endif

			if not(WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE) then
				line2  -_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out,	0,
						_halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out,	0
			else
				line2  -_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_in,		-gs_frame_thk,
						_halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in,	-gs_frame_thk
			endif

			! --- hotspot editing and opening line ------------------------------------
			pen gs_pen_2D
			line_property 0

			_leftSashPosition	= -_halfA + _frame_width_left
			_rightSashPosition	=  _halfA - _frame_width_right

			add2 0, -gs_frame_thk * (WIDO_REVEAL_SIDE)
			gosub "hotspot editing"
			gosub "opening line"
			gosub "unit hotspots"
			del 1

			end ! =============================================================== END =
		endif


		! =============================================================================
		! Straight window panel - Basic symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D = DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_TWO | lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE | lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA then

			_frame_width_left  = gs_frame_width + (gs_sash_width - _rebate_width) * (lod2D <> DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA)
			_frame_width_right = gs_frame_width + (gs_sash_width - _rebate_width) * (lod2D <> DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA)

			pen gs_frame_pen_cont
			line_property 2
			fill gs_fillFr

			! --- left window frame ---------------------------------------------------
			poly2_b 4, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
					-_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out,	 0,				32 + 1,
					-_halfA + _frame_width_left,		 0,				32 + 1,
					-_halfA + _frame_width_left,		-gs_frame_thk,	32 + 1,
					-_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_in,	-gs_frame_thk,	32 + bDrawLeftEndLine

			if lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA then
				add2 0, -(gs_frame_thk - gs_sash_thk) / 2
				poly2_b 4, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left,					 0,				32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left + gs_sash_width,	 0,				32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left + gs_sash_width,	-gs_sash_thk,	32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left,					-gs_sash_thk,	32
				del 1
			endif

			! --- right window frame --------------------------------------------------
			poly2_b 4, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
					_halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out,	 0,            32 + 1,
					_halfA - _frame_width_right,		 0,            32 + 1,
					_halfA - _frame_width_right,		-gs_frame_thk, 32 + 1,
					_halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in,	-gs_frame_thk, 32 + bDrawRightEndLine

			if lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA then
				add2 0, -(gs_frame_thk - gs_sash_thk) / 2
				poly2_b 4, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right,					 0,				32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right - gs_sash_width,	 0,				32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right - gs_sash_width,	-gs_sash_thk,	32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right,					-gs_sash_thk,	32
				del 1
			endif

			if iTypeDemolitionFill = 1 then
				line_type gs_Demolition_linetype
			else
				line_type 1
			endif

			pen gs_pen_2D
			line_property 0

			! --- glass line in the center of the frame --------------------------------
			if bFrCornerLeft <> 0 then
				_leftGlassPos = -_halfA + _frame_width_left + (lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA) * gs_sash_width
			else
				_leftGlassPos = -halfA - (gs_frame_ovhg_left_out + gs_frame_ovhg_left_in) / 2
			endif

			if bFrCornerRight <> 0 then
				_rightGlassPos = _halfA - _frame_width_right - (lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA) * gs_sash_width
			else
				_rightGlassPos = _halfA + (gs_frame_ovhg_right_out + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in) / 2
			endif

			if lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE | lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA then
				line2	_leftGlassPos,  -gs_frame_thk/2,
						_rightGlassPos, -gs_frame_thk/2
			endif

			! --- horizontal lines and cover fill --------------------------------------
			if lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA then
				_frame_thk = gs_sash_thk
				add2 0, -(gs_frame_thk - gs_sash_thk) / 2
			else
				_frame_thk = gs_frame_thk
			endif

			if bFrCornerLeft = 0 then
				_leftIn		= -_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_in
				_leftOut	= -_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out
			else
				_leftIn		= -_halfA + _frame_width_left + (lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA) * gs_sash_width
				_leftOut	= _leftIn
			endif

			if bFrCornerRight = 0 then
				_rightIn	= _halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in
				_rightOut	= _halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out
			else
				_rightIn	= _halfA - _frame_width_right - (lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA) * gs_sash_width
				_rightOut	= _rightIn
			endif

			fill gs_fillShCover

			poly2_b 4, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillShCover > 0) + 4 + 16 + 64, gs_penShCov_fg, gs_penShCov_bg,
					_leftOut,	 0,				1,
					_rightOut,	 0,				0,
					_rightIn,	-_frame_thk,	1,
					_leftIn,	-_frame_thk,	0

			if lod2D = DET2D_FS_MIDDLE_USA then del 1

			! --- hotspot editing and opening line ------------------------------------
			pen gs_pen_2D
			line_property 0

			_leftSashPosition	= -_halfA + _frame_width_left
			_rightSashPosition	=  _halfA - _frame_width_right

			gosub "hotspot editing"
			gosub "opening line"

			pen gs_frame_pen_cont
			line_property 2

			gosub "tolerance line"
			gosub "unit hotspots"
		endif


		! =============================================================================
		! Straight window panel - Detailed symbol
		! =============================================================================
		if lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED then

			pen gs_frame_pen_cont
			line_property 2
			fill gs_fillFr

			! --- left window frame ---------------------------------------------------
			_frame_width_left  = gs_frame_width
			if bFrCornerLeft <> 0 then
				poly2_b 6, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
						-_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out,				 0,								32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left - _rebate_width,	 0,								32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left - _rebate_width,	-gs_frame_thk + _rebate_depth,	32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left,					-gs_frame_thk + _rebate_depth,	32 + 1,
						-_halfA + _frame_width_left,					-gs_frame_thk,					32 + 1,
						-_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_in,				-gs_frame_thk,					32 + bDrawLeftEndLine
			endif

			! --- right window frame --------------------------------------------------
			_frame_width_right  = gs_frame_width
			if bFrCornerRight <> 0 then
				poly2_b 6, 1+2+4+16+32, gs_penFr_fg, gs_penFr_bg,
						_halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out,				 0,								32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right + _rebate_width,	 0,								32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right + _rebate_width,	-gs_frame_thk + _rebate_depth,	32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right,					-gs_frame_thk + _rebate_depth,	32 + 1,
						_halfA - _frame_width_right,					-gs_frame_thk,					32 + 1,
						_halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in,				-gs_frame_thk,					32 + bDrawRightEndLine
			endif

			_leftSashPosition	= -_halfA + _frame_width_left - _rebate_width
			_rightSashPosition	=  _halfA - _frame_width_right + _rebate_width

			pen gs_pen_2D
			if iTypeDemolitionFill = 1 then
				line_type gs_Demolition_linetype
			else
				line_type 1
			endif

			! --- horizontal lines and cover fill --------------------------------------

			fill gs_fillShCover

			poly2_b 8, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillShCover > 0) + 4 + 16 + 64, gs_penShCov_fg,	 gs_penShCov_bg,
				 _leftSashPosition + gs_sash_width,		 gs_sash_thk -_rebate_depth,	0,
				 _leftSashPosition + gs_sash_width,		-_rebate_depth,					0,
				-_halfA + _frame_width_left,			-_rebate_depth,					0,
				-_halfA + _frame_width_left,			-gs_frame_thk,					1,
				 _halfA - _frame_width_right,			-gs_frame_thk,					0,
				 _halfA - _frame_width_right,			-_rebate_depth,					0,
				 _rightSashPosition - gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth,					0,
				 _rightSashPosition - gs_sash_width,	gs_sash_thk -_rebate_depth,		1

			line2	_leftSashPosition + gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth,
					_rightSashPosition - gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth

			! --- glass line in the center of the sash frame --------------------------------

			line2	_leftSashPosition + gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth + gs_sash_thk/2,
					_rightSashPosition - gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth + gs_sash_thk/2

			! --- sash fill for both sides --------------------------------------------
			pen gs_frame_pen_cont
			fill gs_fillSh
			line_property 2

			! left sash frame
			poly2_b 4, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillSh > 0) + 4 + 16 + 32, gs_penSh_fg, gs_penSh_bg,
					_leftSashPosition,					-_rebate_depth,					32 + 1,
					_leftSashPosition + gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth,					32 + 1,
					_leftSashPosition + gs_sash_width,	 gs_sash_thk -_rebate_depth,	32 + 1,
					_leftSashPosition,					 gs_sash_thk -_rebate_depth,	32 + 1

			! right sash frame
			poly2_b 4, 1 + 2 * (gs_fillSh > 0) + 4 + 16 + 32, gs_penSh_fg, gs_penSh_bg,
					_rightSashPosition,					-_rebate_depth,					32 + 1,
					_rightSashPosition - gs_sash_width,	-_rebate_depth,					32 + 1,
					_rightSashPosition - gs_sash_width,	 gs_sash_thk -_rebate_depth,	32 + 1,
					_rightSashPosition,					 gs_sash_thk -_rebate_depth,	32 + 1

			! --- hotspot editing and opening line ------------------------------------
			pen gs_pen_2D
			line_property 0

			gosub "hotspot editing"
			gosub "opening line"

			pen gs_frame_pen_cont
			line_property 2

			gosub "tolerance line"
			gosub "unit hotspots"
		endif
	endif
endif

end


! =============================================================================
"hotspot editing":
! =============================================================================
	unID = sh_UnID
	rev_A = 512
	rev_B = 0

	sash_thk_oh = 0
	if lod2D = DET2D_FS_DETAILED then
		sash_thk_oh = gs_sash_thk/2
	endif

	add2 0, sash_thk_oh

	hotspot2 _rightSashPosition, 0, unID,		gs_open_2D, 6 + rev_A	! Center
	hotspot2 _leftSashPosition,  0, unID + 1,	gs_open_2D, 4+128		! Base
	hotspot2 _rightSashPosition-(abs(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition))*cos(gs_open_2D),
				(abs(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition))*sin(gs_open_2D),
				unID + 2, gs_open_2D,5						! Moving
	unID = unID + 3
	del 1

	sh_UnID = unID
return


! =============================================================================
"opening line":
! =============================================================================
	if abs(gs_open_2D) > EPS & abs(gs_open_2D - 360) > EPS then

		pen gs_opLinePen

		line2	_rightSashPosition, sash_thk_oh,
				_rightSashPosition-(abs(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition))*cos(gs_open_2D),
				(abs(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition))*sin(gs_open_2D) + sash_thk_oh

		line_type gs_swingLineType

		if gs_iSwingType = 1 then		! Curved
			arc2	_rightSashPosition, sash_thk_oh, ABS(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition), 180-gs_open_2D, 180
		else							! Straight
			line2	_leftSashPosition, sash_thk_oh,
					_rightSashPosition-(abs(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition))*cos(gs_open_2D),
					(abs(_leftSashPosition-_rightSashPosition))*sin(gs_open_2D) + sash_thk_oh
		endif

		line_type SYMB_LINETYPE
	endif
return


! =============================================================================
"tolerance line":
! =============================================================================
	if lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & lod2D <> DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI then
		if bFrCornerLeft <> 0 then
			if lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & (gs_frame_ovhg_left_out > EPS | gs_frame_ovhg_left_in > EPS) then
				line2 -_halfA, 0,
					  -_halfA, -gs_frame_thk
			endif
		endif

		if not(bCornerWindow) & bFrCornerRight <> 0 then
			if lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & (gs_frame_ovhg_right_out > EPS | gs_frame_ovhg_right_in > EPS) then
				line2 _halfA, 0,
					  _halfA, -gs_frame_thk
			endif
		endif
	endif
return


! =============================================================================
"unit hotspots":
! =============================================================================
	if bShowUnitHotspots then
		unit_UnID = 1
		if bLeftCornerFunction then
			hotspot2 -_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_out,  0,            unit_UnID
			hotspot2 -_halfA - gs_frame_ovhg_left_in,  -gs_frame_thk * (lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & lod2D <> DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI), unit_UnID + 2
		else
			hotspot2 -_halfA,  0,            unit_UnID
			hotspot2 -_halfA, -gs_frame_thk * (lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & lod2D <> DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI), unit_UnID + 2
		endif
		if not(bCornerWindow) | bRightCornerFunction then
			if bRightCornerFunction then
				hotspot2  _halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_out,  0,            unit_UnID + 1
				hotspot2  _halfA + gs_frame_ovhg_right_in,  -gs_frame_thk * (lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & lod2D <> DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI), unit_UnID + 3
			else
				hotspot2  _halfA,  0,            unit_UnID + 1
				hotspot2  _halfA, -gs_frame_thk * (lod2D > DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_ONE & lod2D <> DET2D_FS_SIMPLE_CHI), unit_UnID + 3
			endif
		endif
	endif
return
